name: plain-transcript
description: The happy path: three named speakers, four labelled assertions, three ledger rows. One claim is made twice, so the run's own factsWritten counter under-reports what the ledger correctly holds.
note: This fixture exists to make the counters ungradeable. The restatement collapse (facts.ts:456) refreshes the row already on file and increments NEITHER factsWritten NOR factsSkipped, so factsWritten (3) is less than the number of labelled assertions (4) while fidelityRecall is 1. A bench that graded report.factsWritten would read that as a 25% loss; the ledger has lost nothing. Both turns restate the claim on the same day with the same confidence, so nothing the refresh writes back can move — the distortion case belongs to distortion-traps.
